prompts.prompt: Use case: game sprite atlas / precise-object-edit. Derive production-ready Quackies WETLANDS BOARD SPACE sprites from the green concept tiles in the reference. ONE 1536x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of 512x512 cells. FIVE tiles only; bottom-right sixth cell entirely transparent. No title, labels, words or numerals anywhere, no duck or encounter tokens, no preview boards. Each tile is top-down flat painted art, not perspective, a softly bubbly irregular rounded rectangle approximately450x366 pixels centered in its cell, matching the reference's beautiful vibrant illustration, confident smooth edges and lightly textured grassy surface. Keep outside alpha truly transparent, no simulated checkerboard. All FIVE tiles MUST have essentially GREEN GRASS surface, including the entire lower-left corner: absolutely NO water, blue pond, puddle, lily pad or lotus. The board itself already contains the water. Small reeds, cattails, grass tufts and little daisies decorate edges. Same overall green hue and same exact tile footprint in every cell. Ordinary tiles have attractive but restrained decorated borders; haven tiles have a richer leafy rim and ONE large white Feather at the top-right corner, protruding a little beyond the rim. Reward artwork baked into every tile, NO NUMBERS: a small golden crescent moon with purple stars sits very low near the BOTTOM at x about40% of tilewidth, y about87% of tileheight; its height about15% of tileheight. Leave a clean blank area directly to its right for live Sleep numerals (x52%-78%,y80%-98%). Thin forked brown twigs occupy a narrow right-side area from x75%-94%, y30%-59%. Leave clean grass immediately below the twig artwork (x77%-97%,y61%-80%) for a live Twig numeral. Keep upper-left through centre (x0%-70%, y0%-78%) OPEN GRASS for a large movable token. No extra scattered sticks mistaken for rewards. Tile recipe by cell: TOP LEFT ordinary with exactly ONE twig and no Feather; TOP CENTRE ordinary with exactly TWO twigs and no Feather; TOP RIGHT ordinary with exactly THREE twigs and no Feather; BOTTOM LEFT haven with exactly ONE twig and exactly ONE white Feather at the upper-right rim; BOTTOM CENTRE haven with exactly THREE twigs and exactly ONE white Feather at the upper-right rim; BOTTOM RIGHT EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Twig counts refer to complete separate sticks, not side branches. Top three ordinary tiles must have no white feather shapes. Moon and twig positions must be consistent across all five. Draw only asset artwork, never numeric values or external reward strips. Crisp professional native sprite quality, no grain, beautiful playful tabletop-game feeling, preserve the reference's distinctive art language. The grass is a single continuous tile surface, with all reward symbols printed inside it and generous open landing space.

Use case: background-extraction. Convert this five-tile sprite sheet into a genuinely transparent PNG. The gray/white checkerboard is currently baked into RGB pixels and MUST be removed completely: make ALL background outside the five grass tile silhouettes and the empty bottom-right cell have actual zero alpha. Preserve the five tile interiors, moon/star artwork, exact twig counts, feather details, fine reeds/leaves at the edges and their exact grid placement. Do not paint transparency as another checkerboard. Output actual RGBA with a transparent background. Keep 1536x1024 and no resize if possible. Nothing else changes; no added tiles, numbers, labels, shadows or backdrop.

Use case: game sprite atlas. Create the matching Quackies MEADOW tile set using reference1 as the precise five-tile atlas/grid/layout reference and reference2 as art-direction reference. NO NUMBERS OR TEXT, NO TOKENS. Grass surface warmer yellow-green than wetlands. Replace cattails/reeds with beautiful meadow edge decoration: small daisies, clover, buttercups and soft grass, no pond or water or lilies. Ordinary tiles attractively decorated but less elaborate than havens. Havens have richer lush green leafy borders and ONE larger white feather at the top-right edge, lightly overhanging. Keep clean smooth high-quality illustration, not gritty or grainy, with all symbols separate from open token landing area. Copy reference1's locations and extents as closely as possible for a common Unity template.

The present twigs are much too wide and invade the token space. In EACH tile, redraw its whole twig reward group as short small twigs contained ENTIRELY WITHIN THE RIGHTMOST QUARTER of the tile surface (x74%-94% of tilewidth,y30%-58% of tileheight). Clear all original brown twig artwork to its left back to matching grass. Leave everything left of 70% width through the top75% of height as the clear grassy landing area. Don't alter the existing five tile positions, overallsize, background or artstyle. This is a practical production-sprite spacing correction. Count twigs carefully.

Reference1 is the exact five-tile grid/template and reward placement; reference2 is the approved orange haven art direction. ONE1536x1024 PNG, strict3columns by2rows of512x512cells, exactly FIVE sprites and bottom-right cell empty. Same soft bubbly footprint and positions as reference1, top-down flat painted illustration. Surface burnt ochre-orange dry soil, matching the approved desert board. TOP THREE ordinary tiles have modest decorative rocks, dead grass, tiny dry shrubs and a few pebbles along the edges; NO lush grass or leafy ring, NO feathers. BOTTOM TWO havens have a noticeably lush green leafy rim, a few little white/yellow flowers, the same orange surface, and exactly TWO LARGE clearly separated white Feathers at the top-right rim that overhang it slightly. Compact short forked twig sticks in RIGHTMOST QUARTER only (x74%-94%, y30%-58%), with a clear blank live Twig-number space immediately underneath. Recipe: TOP LEFT ordinary SIX twigs (3above3), TOP CENTRE ordinary SEVEN twigs (4above3), TOP RIGHT ordinary EIGHT twigs (4above4). BOTTOM LEFT haven SEVEN twigs (4above3) plus2Feathers; BOTTOM CENTRE haven EIGHT twigs (4above4) plus2Feathers. BOTTOM RIGHT EMPTY. Count actual sticks exactly; branch tips are not extra sticks. Keep no backdrop outside sprites, actual alpha preferred; no artificial checkerboard. Crisp beautiful vibrant painterly art without grain; preserve common template proportions and symbols. The havens feel like little pockets of comfort in harsh land.
